cc:Work.dc:title: complete_case_scores
cc:Work.dc:description: Values are descriptive geometric means of ten complete session scores in seconds. Each score sums six query medians, not an observed whole-suite latency. Every cell reports planned-block completeness and query coverage. Polars GPU complex retains four of six supported original queries and has zero complete six-query scores; a partial four-query sum is never substituted. Versions are the fixed study configuration; the renderer does not independently inventory hardware or runtimes.

g.text: Single H100 study host · fixed configuration · four engine paths, five software configurations · primary action endpoint
Values are descriptive geometric means of ten complete session scores in seconds. Each score sums six query medians, not an observed whole-suite latency. Every cell reports
planned-block completeness and query coverage. Polars GPU complex retains four of six supported original queries and has zero complete six-query scores; a partial four-query sum
is never substituted. Versions are the fixed study configuration; the renderer does not independently inventory hardware or runtimes.
